verdict.rationale: An LLM gateway could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no Requesty-owned CLI. Claude Code is Anthropic's terminal tool that users point at Requesty through environment variables, and the API reference offers generated cURL samples. Neither is Requesty's own CLI, so both are adjacent integrations that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
